senses.gloss:
शुटीर शुटीर (apparently not in use), a
hero; [cf. शौटीर.]
—शुटीर-ता, f. or शुटीर-त्व,
अम्, n. heroism.
शुटीर्य, अम्, n. valour, heroism; [cf. शौटीर्य.]

सुट् सुट्, (in grammar) a Pratyāhāra used
as a technical expression for the first five inflections
(i. e. nom. sing. du. pl., acc. sing. du., also called सर्-
वनाम-स्थान, q. v., for masc. and fem. nouns).

सुट्ट् सुट्ट्, cl. 10. P. सुट्टयति, असुषुट्टत्,
to slight, disregard, despise; to be small,
to be low or shallow.
